biggest_gap: Fixed, non-customizable table views that overflow the viewport: the five hard-coded presets cannot be edited, reordered or saved, and at the native 1600x900 the rightmost columns (Status/Value) and the BALANCE header chip are clipped off-screen with horizontal scrolling disabled (screen.gd line 195), so live data (bids, listed state) is literally unreachable — FM24's editable, saveable column views never lose data to the viewport.

history.gap: Squad table and profile are read-only info displays with no player actions (contract renewal, transfer-list, release, training focus), while FM24's equivalents are action hubs via context menus and profile buttons.

No historical dimension anywhere: profile and table show only current-season snapshots; FM24's profile has career history — season-by-season stats, transfer/contract history, attribute progression — that makes a player a trajectory rather than a snapshot.
No at-a-glance ability/potential rating layer (FM's coach-report stars) on the squad table or profile header — judging who to keep, sell or develop requires parsing raw stats and a buried IV%.
No selection/availability layer on the squad table (starting-six membership, availability/status icons, lineup link) — the one FM squad-screen job the screen still cannot do.

history.note: Round-4 gap closed and verified live: Picked column (slot + role, bench order S1..Sn) on all four views, bound to the saved tactic in GameState.world.meta.tactics (mutation test: swapping the lineup re-ranked the table instantly) and the same plan demonstrably drives interactive and instant-simmed results via the tactics director. Availability flags (EXH/TRD, UNF/FIT, status ailments, LST, UNH) with severity colors, dot icons and tooltips; PICKED SIX x/6 fit header chip degrades to warn state; footer strip and profile header carry PICKED + AVAILABILITY. Secondary nits: Avail column truncates stacked flags ('TRD U'), no lineup-editing affordance from the squad screen itself (no 'make starter' context action or Tactics shortcut), no expected-recovery estimate on fatigue flags.

history.gap: No qualitative personality/happiness layer: morale is an opaque 0-100 word with no reasons, concerns, expectations or promises anywhere on the squad table or profile, while FM24 surrounds every number with personality traits, squad-status expectations and explained happiness that actually drive keep/sell/renew decisions.
history.note: Everything else verified REAL end-to-end with fresh eyes: 4 dense table presets with live season stats (apps/KOs/dmg/ratings accumulate over 40 simmed days), sortable columns + filter + right-click menus; multi-round contract talks with budget guards and walk-away locks (dialog verified live); transfer listing generated genuine AI bids that expire and can be accepted for real squad+finance mutations (offers dialog verified via driver); profile has attributes with IV/squad-rank, compare-with deltas, matchups, moves, form log, percentile coach report tied to named staff judging stats; History tab has season stats, attribute progression, value sparklines, transfer/contract/dev logs. Cross-screen coherence strong (tactic roles in Picked column, held items link to Items, training-focus bridge, inbox messages for every action, matchday redirect). Verdict is NARROW — FM edge only on the qualitative context layer plus secondaries: no customizable/saveable column views (4 fixed presets), contract talks lack clause depth (appearance/win bonuses, promises, agent flavour), career records start at takeover (no pre-career/cross-club history), and commercial-grade art polish is out of reach of the no-copyrighted-art constraint.

Gap closed: full qualitative layer. personality.gd: 4 hidden character attributes (deterministic per career+uid) -> FM archetypes (Model Professional/Fiery/Driven...); squad-status expectation tiers (Star/Important/Youth Prospect/Squad/Backup) from in-squad ability rank; happiness = explained factor ledger (playing time vs status, form, wage-fairness vs squad rank, contract runway, listing, collapsed talks, promises, team position/results, condition, praise/criticism) each with detail sentence, signed weight and resolve action. SquadService: every morale mutation flows through apply_morale into a per-mon mood ledger with dated reasons; match results move real morale (temperament-scaled); morale drifts 1/day toward structural happiness; residual attribution logs out-of-service changes (training load); promises are real state (battles-in-28-days checked vs genuine appearance data, new-deal kept by actual renewals, unlist) with deadlines, kept/broken inbox mail, squad-wide trust fallout and contract-demand poisoning; personality scales praise/criticism, walk-out patience, wage demands, listing/break penalties.
